description: This file defines the interface IPlacementDirector within the Orleans runtime for placement logic. It includes a constant key, a method for selecting a silo for activation, and a static method for retrieving placement hints from request context data.

classes.name: IPlacementDirector
classes.description: Interface for placement directors responsible for choosing appropriate silos for grain activation within Orleans.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the appropriate silo address for placing the specified grain activation based on the provided strategy, target, and context.

methods.name: GetPlacementHint
methods.description: Static method that retrieves the placement hint from request context data if present and valid, considering only compatible silos.
